## Checklist

- [ ] The runbook uses the template in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#runbook-template).
- [ ] The runbook is self-contained. It does not tell the assistant to read a different runbook.
- [ ] The change has no real customer names, site names, interface tags, IP addresses, or account IDs.
- [ ] A new runbook is in the table in [README.md](../README.md#runbooks).
- [ ] `./scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] I tested the runbook with an assistant on real data. <!-- Say which assistant. -->
